name: Ecology and Evolutionary Biology (EBIO) PhD

publishedDeadlines.label: Application
publishedDeadlines.note: Undated annual deadline from official admissions overview; central FAQ closes at 10 p.m. MST.

english.note: Pearson 58; Cambridge 180. Central default applies; EBIO's older page says iBT 79, so higher current central 80 retained. Qualifying citizenship or recent university study can exempt.

applicationFee.note: Domestic fee $60; international $80. Central waivers for qualifying U.S. citizens/PR, military and possible DACA/undocumented applicants; inquire with department.

documents: Select prospective faculty advisor(s) in application
requirements.note: Contact prospective advisors before applying; formal admission requires a faculty member requesting admission.

timeline.interviews: Typically mid-February on-site interview and visit.
